detaileddescription.para: Check if this free is accessed after its argument has been test against NULL (property 0). If yes, it is legal to move this call in its predecessor block.

The move is performed only if the block containing the call to free will be removed, i.e.:
it has only one predecessor P, and P has two successors
it contains the call, noops, and an unconditional branch
its successor is the same as its predecessor's successor
The profitability is out-of concern here and this function should be called only if the caller knows this transformation would be profitable (e.g., for code size).
